name: unscreenshot
description: Rebuild a slide image (screenshot, PNG, JPG, PDF page) as an editable PowerPoint that matches it pixel for pixel.

interface.longDescription: Give Codex a picture of a slide (screenshot, PNG, JPG, PDF page) and get back a .pptx where every text box, bullet, card, line and colour is measured on the image and rebuilt as a native, editable PowerPoint object.
defaultPrompt: Rebuild this slide image as an editable PowerPoint.
Turn these screenshots into one editable .pptx, one slide each.
Convert this PDF page to an editable slide, identical.
